purpose: Bind prior exact-source F-PM08D surface-water reconstruction into the SWAP5-Ribasim ownership decomposition.

legacy_execution_order: SurfaceWater task 2 computes drainage/exchange before SoilWater.
SoilWater consumes the distributed drainage source/sink and can alter runoff/rapid-drainage terms.
SurfaceWater task 3 resolves prescribed levels or advances simulated secondary storage after SoilWater.

state_classes.SWST: authoritative conserved secondary surface-water storage for SWSEC=2
state_classes.WLS: derived from SWST in simulated mode; forcing in prescribed mode
state_classes.WLSTAR: continuation-critical automatic-control target memory for SWMAN=2
state_classes.WLSBAK: numerical oscillation history, not physical state
state_classes.NUMADJ: diagnostic counter, not continuation-critical physical state

exact_source_findings.exchange_law: Extended drainage/infiltration law is stateless process physics using resolved surface-water head and drainage geometry/resistances.
exact_source_findings.availability_limiter: State-dependent physical coupling limiter that scales secondary drainage/infiltration based on projected SWST plus maximum supply; it is not part of the constitutive drainage law.
exact_source_findings.secondary_balance: S1-S0 = dt*(q_drain_secondary + q_rapid + q_supply - q_discharge) + V_top_surface_exchange
exact_source_findings.fixed_weir: SWMAN=1 uses storage targets derived from HBWEIR/WLDIP, explicit supply need and Q(h) discharge balance.
exact_source_findings.automatic_weir: SWMAN=2 selects target from groundwater level, total air volume and selected pressure head; WLSTAR persists between explicit adjustment events.
exact_source_findings.swqhr2_hold: Tabular rating has a legacy HBWEIR threshold seam; direct Q(h) table is stronger physical authority than inferred crest semantics.
exact_source_findings.automatic_capacity_hold: Legacy SWQHR1 and SWQHR2 automatic capacity checks sample different heads and contain a documented source discrepancy.

SWAP_UNCONSTRAINED_EXCHANGE_PHYSICS: rapid drainage/interflow generation where separately qualified
COUPLER_EXCHANGE_FEASIBILITY: combine SWAP requested signed exchange with Ribasim-owned available water/state
produce exactly one authoritative limited signed transfer
prevent state-dependent legacy SWST/WSCAP limiter from remaining hidden inside SWAP when Ribasim owns those quantities
COUPLER_MANAGEMENT_POLICY: automatic target selection from accepted SWAP hydraulic state
explicit event schedule replacing legacy calendar arithmetic

design_consequence: In Ribasim-coupled mode SWAP may compute an unconstrained infiltration/drainage response, but it may not independently limit that response using a private duplicate of Ribasim surface-water storage/supply state. The final signed exchange must be resolved once across the coupling boundary.
q2_consequence: Automatic-weir target selection can be preserved as management policy, while hydraulic capacity realization belongs to Ribasim. The documented legacy SWQHR1/SWQHR2 capacity asymmetry must be adjudicated, not silently reproduced.
